mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification ( user_id, patient_id, notification_type, title, content, related_type, related_id, channel, status, template_id, template_data, is_read, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{patientId}, #{notificationType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{templateId}, #{templateData}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET status = #{status}, send_time = CASE WHEN #{time} IS NOT NULL THEN #{time} ELSE send_time END, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (is_read = 0 OR is_read IS NULL)
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1, read_time = #{readTime}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
